title: ข้อสอบคัดเลือกค่าย 1 สอวน. เคมี ปี 2560
subject: เคมี
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)
note: PARTIAL: source Part I questions 1–51 are reviewed, solved and generated (51/70). Source has 60 MC questions and 10 written questions with restarted numbering; written questions will be internal 61–70. Remaining 19 are pending. MC11 has no correct printed choice; its adaptation asks the corrected rankings. MC43 has two correct printed choices; its adaptation asks for the pair. MC50 only implies sufficient BaCl2, not exact stoichiometry; its adaptation states exact addition. Raw extraction stays in the private bank; unreviewed extraction is not a verified transcript. Do not interpret 51/51 solver checks as whole-paper completion.

items.note: Uses general solubility rules for the source ion pool; precipitation in a real mixture depends on concentrations and pH. Variants change soluble group-1 and spectator ions while preserving the three relevant precipitates.

items.title: สีของแฮโลเจนและลำดับอิเล็กโทรเนกาติวิตี

items.title: ลำดับจุดเดือดของไฮโดรเจนเฮไลด์

items.note: Normal boiling points approximately -85.1, -66.8, -35.4, +19.5 deg C respectively. HCl/HBr/HI rise with dispersion; HF is highest through hydrogen bonding. Reference: https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/ ; variants use three-member subsets.

items.title: จำแนกสารจากการนำไฟฟ้า
items.source: Part I, question 20, p8: source table A conducts solid and liquid, C conducts liquid and water solution, D conducts only in water solution; printed choice ค gives C,D,A for ionic,covalent,metal.
items.figure: Rendered p8 table visually checked for all melting/boiling and conductivity entries. The generated stem renders those entries as text, without reusing the source image.
items.topic: สมบัติของสารไอออนิก โคเวเลนต์ และโลหะ
items.note: SOURCE AMBIGUITY: B, D and E are all molecular covalent by conductivity; only D is the printed covalent choice paired with C and A. The adaptation explicitly asks for the covalent substance whose aqueous solution conducts, making D unique. Variants relabel the five source rows.

items.title: ไอออนที่มีพันธะไนโตรเจนออกซิเจนสั้นที่สุด
items.source: Part I, question 21, p8: among NO+, NO2-, NO2+ and NO3-, nitrosonium NO+ has the shortest N-O bond, choice ก.
items.figure: Rendered p8 checked the superscript charges and subscripts in each printed choice.
items.topic: อันดับพันธะและความยาวพันธะ
items.note: NO+ bond order 3 and observed N-O length about 1.06 A, shorter than NO2+ near 1.116 A, neutral NO near 1.15 A and nitrite/nitrate near 1.24-1.26 A. Variants include neutral NO but retain NO+; bond order alone does not rank neutral NO against NO2+ because their measured lengths reverse that simple trend. Sources: https://journals.iucr.org/m/issues/2021/02/00/lt5036/lt5036.pdf ; https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1107/S1600536807000207 .

items.title: คู่สารที่มีรูปร่างโมเลกุลเหมือนกัน
items.source: Part I, question 22, p8: BF4- and POCl3 are both tetrahedral, choice ง; ICl4- is square planar and TeCl4 seesaw.
items.figure: Rendered p8 checked superscript minus charges on BF4- and ICl4- and all four printed pairs.
items.topic: รูปร่างโมเลกุลตาม VSEPR
items.note: Shape comparison uses central-atom AXE domains; P=O in POCl3 counts as one domain. Variants match square-planar, seesaw and trigonal-pyramidal pairs.

items.title: มุมพันธะที่เล็กที่สุด
items.source: Part I, question 23, p8: among ClF3, SiF4, NCl3 and OCl2, ClF3 has the smallest F-Cl-F angle, choice ก.
items.figure: Rendered p8 checked the four printed formulas.
items.topic: มุมพันธะและรูปร่างโมเลกุล
items.note: Compares the smallest angle within each molecule. NIST CCCBDB reports ClF3 87.45 deg, NCl3 107.1 deg and OCl2 about 110.88 deg; SiF4 is tetrahedral near 109.5 deg. Variants may use ClF5 at 86.5 deg. Reference: https://cccbdb.nist.gov/expangle2x.asp?all=0&descript=aFClF ; https://cccbdb.nist.gov/exp2x.asp?casno=7791211&charge=0 .

items.title: คู่โดดเดี่ยวบนอะตอมกลางมากที่สุด

items.figure: Rendered p9 checked superscript charges on NO2- and SO3(2-).

items.note: Counts electron pairs on the central atom only. Variants compare I3-, XeF4, ClF3 and SF4 with source species; each pool has a unique maximum.

items.title: โมเลกุลไม่มีขั้วจากรูปร่าง
items.source: Part I, question 25, p9: SF4, SCl2, PCl3 and PF5; PF5 is nonpolar, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p9 visually checked all four choices and molecular subscripts.
items.topic: ขั้วโมเลกุลและรูปร่างโมเลกุล
items.note: PF5 has a symmetric trigonal-bipyramidal arrangement; the bond dipoles cancel. Source page and all four subscripts visually checked.

items.title: สารประกอบที่มีพันธะไอออนิกและโคเวเลนต์
items.source: Part I, question 26, p9: Na2O, COCl2, H2SO4 and CaCO3; CaCO3 contains both bonding types, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p9 visually checked all four choices and molecular subscripts.
items.topic: พันธะไอออนิกและโคเวเลนต์ในสารประกอบ
items.note: The adaptation explicitly considers pure compounds: Ca2+ and CO3(2-) form an ionic crystal, while the carbonate ion has covalent C–O bonds. This avoids treating aqueous acid ionization as an ionic bond in pure H2SO4.

items.title: ภาพลูอิสแบบโคออร์ดิเนตของโอโซน
items.source: Part I, question 27, p9: H2O2, O3, H2CO and CH2NH; textbook coordinate-bond representation selects ozone, choice ข.
items.figure: Rendered p9 visually checked all four choices and molecular subscripts.
items.topic: พันธะโคออร์ดิเนตและเรโซแนนซ์
items.note: The source convention allows O=O→O as a donor–acceptor Lewis depiction. This is bookkeeping, not a localized distinct bond: actual ozone has two equivalent O–O bonds through resonance. The generated prompt states that the arrow is a model. Reference: https://www.open.edu/openlearn/mod/oucontent/view.php?id=87848&section=_unit5.2 .

items.title: รูปร่างของออกไซด์แก๊สมีตระกูล
items.source: Part I, question 28, p9: formal KrO2H2 geometry; with two Kr=O and two Kr-H bonds, AX4E gives seesaw, choice ค.
items.figure: Rendered p9 visually checked formula subscripts, four table rows or reaction fragments.
items.topic: รูปร่างโมเลกุลตาม VSEPR
items.note: The Lewis/VSEPR model is stated in the generator; no claim is made that free KrO2H2 is isolable. The source formula and four shape choices were visually checked.

items.title: ตรวจชื่อสารจากสูตรเคมี
items.source: Part I, question 29, p9: CrO3/chromium trioxide, Na2S2O3/sodium thiosulfate, Hg2Cl2/mercury(I) chloride, Ba(NO2)2/barium nitrite.

items.note: SOURCE ERROR: all four printed names match their formulas, so the request to select an incorrect pair has no valid choice. The adaptation asks how many pairs are wrong (0 in the source); variants deliberately change 1–3 names. Cross-checked against PubChem CIDs 14915, 24477, 24956, 166820.

items.title: การสลายพันธะคู่คาร์บอนคาร์บอน

items.note: The source reactions appear without visible bond strokes in the PDF. The adaptation prints the parent C=C explicitly and distinguishes C=C cleavage from adjacent C-C and two C-H cleavages.

items.title: กฎออกเตตของไอออนอินเตอร์แฮโลเจน
items.source: Part I, question 31, p9: IF, IF2+, IF3(2+) and IF4+; only IF4+ has an expanded central shell, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p9/p10 visually checked charge superscripts, formulas and all printed choices.
items.topic: กฎออกเตตและโครงสร้างลูอิส
items.note: After F atoms reach octets, central I has respectively 8, 8, 8 and 10 electrons. The generated prompt states the single-bond Lewis model.

items.title: คู่โมเลกุลที่มีขั้วทั้งสองชนิด
items.source: Part I, question 32, p9: HCN/KrF4, AsI5/SBr2, ClH3/TeF4 and SO3/PBr3; the intended VSEPR pair is ClH3/TeF4, choice ค.
items.figure: Rendered p9/p10 visually checked charge superscripts, formulas and all printed choices.

items.note: SOURCE MODEL ASSUMPTION: ClH3 is printed exactly; as a formal AX3E2 Lewis species it is T-shaped and polar, but the adaptation does not claim an isolable molecule. TeF4 is AX4E seesaw and polar. The competing partners KrF4, AsI5 and SO3 are symmetric/nonpolar.

items.title: ผลของอุณหภูมิต่อสมบัติของเหลว
items.source: Part I, question 33, p10: on cooling, the printed false statement is that intermolecular attraction decreases, choice ง.

items.note: The adaptation specifies the same liquid and fixed molecular separation for the force comparison; a temperature change alters kinetic energy, vapor pressure and surface tension, not the pair-force law at that distance. Reference: https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/10-2-properties-of-liquids and https://openstax.org/books/chemistry-2e/pages/10-3-phase-transitions .

items.note: 273 C is about 546 K; the halved pressure and halved absolute temperature cancel. The adaptation explicitly defines STP as 1 atm and 0 C.

items.title: ตรวจข้อความจากกฎแก๊สอุดมคติ
items.source: Part I, question 39, p11: 25 C to 50 C at fixed V and mass does not double gas pressure, choice ค.

items.note: The ratio of pressures is 323.15/298.15, about 1.084, not 2. Other claims follow PV=nRT and rho=PM/RT.

items.title: มวลแก๊สจากความหนาแน่นที่ STP
items.source: Part I, question 40, p11: 1.25 g/L and five moles at STP give 140 g, choice ข.
items.figure: Rendered p11 visually checked all printed values and choices.
items.topic: ปริมาตรโมลาร์และความหนาแน่นแก๊ส
items.note: Uses the school convention 22.4 L/mol at STP. Five moles occupy 112 L and have mass 140 g.

items.title: เวลาแพร่ผ่านรูพรุนตามกฎของเกรแฮม
items.source: Part I, question 41, p11: H2 takes 12 s and O2 takes 48 s for the same amount through the same porous sheet, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p11 visually checked all printed values and choices.
items.topic: กฎการแพร่ของเกรแฮม
items.note: At fixed conditions and equal amount, effusion time is proportional to sqrt(molar mass). The O2/H2 mass ratio is 16, so the time ratio is four.

items.title: ร้อยละทองแดงในโลหะผสม Zn–Cu
items.source: Part I, question 42, p11: 5.00 g alloy produces 2.72 g ZnCl2, giving 74.0% Cu by mass, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p11 visually checked all printed values and choices.
items.topic: องค์ประกอบโลหะผสมและปริมาณสัมพันธ์
items.note: Uses Zn=65.0 and Cl=35.5; 2.72 g ZnCl2 is 0.020 mol, so zinc mass is 1.30 g and copper mass is 3.70 g.

items.title: ปริมาณสัมพันธ์ของเตาถลุงเหล็ก

items.note: SOURCE ERROR: two printed options are correct. The adaptation asks for the pair of true statements; source values use Fe=56, C=12 and 22.4 L/mol at STP.

items.title: ปริมาตร CO₂ สำหรับปฏิกิริยากับ LiOH
items.source: Part I, question 44, p12: 240 g LiOH reacts with 5 mol CO2, needing about 205 L at 1 atm and 500 K, choice ค.
items.figure: Rendered p11/p12 visually checked equations, subscripts, values and choices.
items.topic: ปริมาณสัมพันธ์และสมการแก๊สอุดมคติ
items.note: Uses 2LiOH + CO2 -> Li2CO3 + H2O, M(LiOH)=24 g/mol and R=0.082 L atm mol^-1 K^-1.

items.title: ระบุคาร์บอเนตจากกรดและ CO₂
items.source: Part I, question 45, p12: 0.040 mol HCl and 448 cm3 CO2 imply 0.020 mol carbonate; 3.94 g corresponds to BaCO3, choice ง.
items.figure: Rendered p11/p12 visually checked equations, subscripts, values and choices.
items.topic: การหาสูตรสารจากปริมาณสัมพันธ์
items.note: The HCl and CO2 data independently agree on carbonate amount. BaCO3 molar mass is 197 g/mol using Ba=137, C=12, O=16.

items.title: สารกำหนดปริมาณของการผลิตเมทานอล
items.source: Part I, question 46, p12: 350 g CO and 65.0 g H2 produce at most 400 g CH3OH, choice ก.
items.figure: Rendered p12 visually checked powers of ten, formula subscripts, values and choices.
items.topic: สารกำหนดปริมาณและมวลผลิตภัณฑ์
items.note: CO is limiting: 12.5 mol CO needs 25 mol H2, less than the available 32.5 mol H2; yield is 12.5 mol times 32 g/mol.

items.title: จำนวนอะตอม H ในเกลือไฮเดรต
items.source: Part I, question 47, p12: Na2SO4·xH2O has 47.0% water; 50.0 g contains 1.57×10^24 H atoms, choice ค.
items.figure: Rendered p12 visually checked powers of ten, formula subscripts, values and choices.
items.topic: องค์ประกอบร้อยละและจำนวนอนุภาคของไฮเดรต
items.note: The water is 23.5 g. Two H atoms per water molecule gives 2(23.5/18)(6.02×10^23)=1.57×10^24; x inferred from the stated percentage is 7.

items.title: เปรียบเทียบมวลจากโมเลกุลและปริมาตรแก๊ส
items.source: Part I, question 48, p12: a is H2 30.1×10^23 molecules; b is NH3 3.36 dm3 STP; c is X 1.5×10^22 molecules with 0.25 mol weighing 22 g; choice ก gives a>b>c.
items.figure: Rendered p12 visually checked powers of ten, formula subscripts, values and choices.
items.topic: โมล จำนวนอนุภาค และมวลแก๊ส
items.note: Masses are 10.0 g, 2.55 g, and about 2.19 g respectively using N_A=6.02×10^23 and 22.4 L/mol at STP.

items.title: สูตรไฮโดรคาร์บอนจากปริมาตรการเผาไหม้
items.source: Part I, question 49, p12: 20 cm3 hydrocarbon consumes 130 cm3 O2 and makes 80 cm3 CO2; x=4, y=10, water vapor=100 cm3, choice ง.

items.topic: ปริมาตรแก๊สและสมการการเผาไหม้
items.note: Equal-condition gas volumes follow mole ratios: CO2/hydrocarbon=4 and O2/hydrocarbon=6.5, so C4H10.

items.title: ปริมาณตะกอน BaSO₄ และไอออน Na⁺
items.source: Part I, question 50, p12: with exact-equivalence BaCl2 addition, X=40 cm3 and BaSO4=2.33 g; Na+ is 0.92% w/v, not 4.6%; intended choice ค.
items.figure: Rendered p12/p13 visually checked reaction formulas, charges, units and choices.
items.topic: ปริมาณสัมพันธ์ของการตกตะกอน
items.note: SOURCE AMBIGUITY: the printed text says all sulfate precipitates, allowing excess BaCl2 and therefore X>=40 cm3; a need not be true. Adaptation explicitly requires stoichiometric BaCl2 and additive liquid volumes.

items.title: ตรวจปริมาณ H₂ ZnCl₂ และ HCl ที่เหลือ
items.source: Part I, question 51, p13: 1.30 g Zn and 0.600 mol HCl give 0.448 L H2, 2.72% w/v ZnCl2; HCl consumed 0.040 mol and left 0.560 mol, choice ก.
items.figure: Rendered p12/p13 visually checked reaction formulas, charges, units and choices.
